sentences.text: Lab Report: Training dynamics of deep models
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
We trained each model for 30 epochs with a batch size of 128.
The dataset was split into 70 percent training data and the rest for testing.
Figure 1 shows the validation accuracy by dataset.
As shown in Figure 1, Baseline outperforms DistilBERT by 25.1 percentage points on AG News.
On AG News, MobileNet obtains a validation accuracy of 75.4%.
On IMDB, MobileNet leads DistilBERT by 26.5 points.
Figure 2 shows the accuracy of Transformer by dataset.
As shown in Figure 2, Transformer is about 10 points higher on AG News than on SST-2.
Transformer scores about 10 points higher on AG News than on SST-2.
Evaluated on SST-2, Transformer comes in at 61.0% accuracy.
Figure 3 shows the accuracy of Baseline by dataset.
Baseline is 20.2 points higher on Fashion-MNIST than on CIFAR-10 (Figure 3).
As shown in Figure 3, Baseline scores 7.2 points higher on CIFAR-10 than on AG News.
Naive Bayes reaches 87.4% accuracy on QQP.
The differences between the models are discussed in the next section.
